name: es-toolkit
notes: yarn 4 (PnP) via corepack; install adds @oxc-project/runtime so the transformer's lowered helper imports resolve. find.ts/findLast.ts ignored: their tests assert the runtime TypeError text 'doesMatch is not a function', which mangling renames (name-sensitivity, not a semantic bug). tests/check-dist.spec.ts excluded: it runs `yarn pack`->build (tsdown dts bundle) which fails on minified .ts because type-only exports are stripped -- a build/dts-tooling gate, not a runtime bug.

name: zod
install: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter zod add @oxc-project/runtime && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('vitest.minified.mjs',Buffer.from('','base64').toString())"
notes: pnpm monorepo. The zod vitest project hard-enables tsc typecheck (checker:tsc, projects:['packages/*']), which cannot be disabled via CLI and legitimately fails on minified .ts (types are stripped) -- a static type gate, not a runtime bug. install writes vitest.minified.mjs, a standalone config that keeps zod's resolve conditions (@zod/source -> src), the fail-on-console setup, and all src/**/*.test.ts runtime tests, but sets typecheck.enabled=false. install also adds @oxc-project/runtime so the transformer's lowered helper imports resolve. All 168 runtime test files / 1959 runtime tests pass on minified source.

name: dayjs
notes: npm; jest 22 (pinned by repo). install adds @oxc-project/runtime and writes jest.minified.config.json. That config (a) adds a moduleNameMapper so jest 22 -- which predates the package `exports` field -- resolves the transformer's lowered helper imports to node_modules/@oxc-project/runtime/src/*, and (b) excludes test/locale/keys.test.js, which asserts on source-file comment text (locale.file.match(/\/\/ (.*) \[/)) that minification strips -- a source-text/lint gate, not a runtime bug. test bypasses the package.json `test` script's TZ wrappers and 100% coverage threshold. 92 suites / 630 tests pass on minified source.

name: js-yaml
install: npm install && npm install --no-save @oxc-project/runtime && npm run spec:get && npm run build && node -e "const f='package.json',p=require('./'+f);p.exports['.'].import='./src/index.ts';p.exports['.'].require='./src/index.ts';require('fs').writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(p,null,2))"
notes: Repo was restructured since the brief's stale config (no lib/index.js/mocha): sources are now src/**/*.ts, tests run via node --test (Node 24 strips TS types natively) and import the package by name ('js-yaml'), which self-references to the built dist bundle. install repoints the package `exports['.']` to ./src/index.ts so 'js-yaml' resolves to the minified source at runtime instead of a rebuilt bundle -- otherwise the minifier output would be laundered through vite. install also runs `npm run build` (so test/core/dist.test.mjs, which imports the built dist, still passes) and `spec:get` (downloads the yaml-test-suite for test/spec), and adds @oxc-project/runtime for the lowered helper imports. Bypasses the package.json `test` script's eslint + tsc --noEmit gates (both reject minified .ts non-semantically). 1611 tests / 1598 pass / 13 skipped on minified source.

name: ms
notes: pnpm; single source file src/index.ts, tests import './index' via ts-jest. `--coverage=false` bypasses jest.config.ts's 100% coverage threshold (minification legitimately drops branches/dead code); `--env node` runs the nodejs suite and skips the edge-runtime env. 4 suites / 167 tests pass on minified source.

name: debug
notes: npm; CommonJS, src/*.js required via ./src. Runs the package.json `test:node` mocha suite directly, skipping `test:browser` (karma/headless-chrome, not a runtime-semantics gate) and `lint` (xo, rejects minified style). 16 tests pass on minified source.

name: semver
notes: npm; CommonJS. Repo moved from npm/semver to npm/node-semver (package name still `semver`). tap 16: `--no-coverage` (the brief's `--disable-coverage` is not a valid tap 16 flag) bypasses tap's coverage enforcement, which minification legitimately fails; also skips the `posttest` eslint. 51 test files pass on minified source.
